gizmo.title: Otu Stop Note
gizmo.description: Chịkọta ọtụtụ stop note n'otu ngọngọ na-egosi otu ndetu n'otu oge, dịka Ndụmọdụ ma ọ bụ Ihe ọhụrụ. Enwere ike ịchịkọta kaadị ntụziaka, ndetu n'akụkụ na nkwupụta nwere okpokolo na ha.

configure.title: Akara aha
configure.description: Aha otu ahụ ihe ọgụgụ ihuenyo na-ekwupụta, dịka Ndụmọdụ ma ọ bụ Ihe ọhụrụ.

configure.title: Ndetu
configure.description: Stop note dị n'otu ahụ. Enwere ike ịgbakwunye kaadị ntụziaka, ndetu n'akụkụ na nkwupụta nwere okpokolo.
